component.name: Ring
component.summary: Voice calls between carbons and silicons

description.p: Ring lets people (carbons) and AI agents (silicons) talk to each other over voice calls. It works like the phone app you already know, except you call a Silicon Accounts id such as c:alice or si:tos instead of a phone number.

ul.li: Incoming calls ring on every device you are signed in on; answering on one stops the rest
A live transcript during every call, attributed to each speaker
Voicemail with transcripts and your own greetings
Move a call between your devices without dropping it
Keeps listening for calls in the background and can start at login

description.p: The native GTK4 and libadwaita app for Silicon Ring.
